rubytail.definition:
n. A European gold wasp (Chrysis ignita) which has the under
   side of the abdomen bright red, and the other parts deep bluish green
   with a metallic luster. The larva is parasitic in the nests of other
   wasps and of bees.

rubythroat.definition:
n. Any one of numerous species of humming birds belonging
   to Trochilus, Calypte, Stellula, and allies, in which the male has on
   the throat a brilliant patch of red feathers having metallic
   reflections; esp., the common humming bird of the Eastern United States
   (Trochilus colubris).
